claims.claim: North Korean state media condemned the United States for delivering new F-16V Block 70 fighter jets to Taiwan on October 7, 2026.
claims.episode_span: North Korean state media condemned the United States for delivering new F-16V Block 70 fighter jets to Taiwan.
claims.source_title: North Korea warns U.S. over Taiwan while Kim pledges support for Russia
claims.supporting_quote: State media KCNA condemned the recent delivery to Taiwan of new F-16V Block 70 fighter jets from the U.S.

claims.claim: Shiranthi Rajapaksa was arrested in connection with her Siriliya Saviya Foundation over allegations involving 10 million rupees in donations.
claims.episode_span: The case involves roughly 10 million rupees collected for a PET scanner that investigators say had already been donated by China.
claims.source_title: Sri Lanka arrests ex-First Lady in charity graft probe
claims.supporting_quote: Police said the authorities wanted to question Shiranthi over the 10 million rupees ($30,300) of donations collected by her Siriliya Saviya charity for a PET scanner intended for a local cancer hospital.
